label: Cars and motorcycles
prechecks: Switch the engine off and let it cool.
Set the parking brake and chock the wheels.
Never work under a car held only by a jack.
Disconnect the 12 V battery negative terminal for electrical work.
prompt_hint: This is automotive work around hot parts, fluids and heavy components. Confirm the engine is cool and the vehicle is secured before any removal, and name each bolt and hose.
